name: THEORY//LAB Epistemic Ontology

principles.epistemic_separation: Documentary, bridge and theoretical layers never silently collapse.
principles.exegesis_firewall: Theory is excluded when reconstructing an author.
principles.non_destructive_time: Feedback changes current status without deleting previous states.
principles.ai_non_authority: AI suggestions remain ghost relations until explicitly accepted.
principles.structured_ignorance: Questions, contradictions and epistemic debt are first-class entities.
principles.semantic_zoom: Different epistemic scales reveal different ontological granularity.
principles.counterfactual_audit: Any source or author can be temporarily removed to inspect theoretical dependence without mutating the graph.
principles.research_chain: reduction/operation → what intensifies → possible experience → possible human end is a query template, not an ontology imposed on authors.
